eyebrow: Web & AI agency for small businesses
subtitle: C&M Agency is Manon and Christopher. We design and build custom websites, online stores, business apps and AI automations for small businesses.

heroCards.title: Websites
heroCards.text: Get found on Google and receive enquiries.

heroCards.title: E-commerce
heroCards.text: An online store you run yourself.

heroCards.title: Business apps
heroCards.text: Mobile or web, built around how you work.

heroCards.title: AI & automation
heroCards.text: Follow-ups, data entry, email sorting: automated.

services.titleHighlight: all built by the two of us.
services.lead:
Every project starts with a free, detailed, line-by-line quote
and ends with the code and every access handed over in your name.

models.lead: We designed and built these templates ourselves: they are demonstration projects, not client work. You pick a base and we adapt it to your copy, photos and colours.

difference.lead: Your needs are never rephrased by a go-between: the person who listens to you and the person who builds work on the same file, and you talk to both directly.

features.title: A direct relationship
features.text: From the first call to launch day

points.title: One business contact
points.text: Manon has known your project since the first call. You never have to explain your needs twice.

points.title: Direct line to the developer
points.text: A technical question? Ask Christopher directly: he writes the code.

points.title: No subcontracting
points.text: Your project is never resold or handed to a third party, in France or abroad.

points.title: You own the code
points.text: Source code, accounts, hosting: everything is in your name. No leasing, no forced subscription.

duo.lead: No fake agency of thirty people. Two people, whom you know by name, from the first call to launch day.

people.name: Manon
people.text: She answers your first enquiry, gets to know your business, prepares the quote and keeps you posted at every stage. She is your point of reference until launch.

people.name: Christopher
people.text: He develops your website, app or automations, puts them online and maintains them. He builds what you signed off and explains his choices plainly.

duo.tagline: The C and the M in C&M Agency

method.lead:
Four stages, with your sign-off at the end of each one.
You follow progress through demos, and nothing outside the quote
is billed without your written agreement.

steps.title: We discover
steps.text: A first conversation to understand your business, your goals, your constraints and what you really expect from the project.

steps.title: We scope
steps.text: We clarify the scope, priorities, content, timeline and budget before production starts.

steps.title: We design & build
steps.text: Mockups, iterative development, regular demos and your feedback folded in as the work progresses.

steps.title: We launch & evolve
steps.text: Go-live, onboarding, fine-tuning, maintenance and optimisation to make the results last.
